page_title: MNU 0-1 ARS | Manchester Utd v Arsenal 12/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Paul Tierney is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+7' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a cross into the box, but David Raya comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+6' A pass from Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) is intercepted by David Raya and the move breaks down.
90+4' Yellow card! It's like David Raya (Arsenal) was asking for a caution with his behaviour. Paul Tierney agrees and books him.
90+4' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post.
90+3' Mikel Arteta has decided to substitute Martin Odegaard and he is replaced by Jorginho (Arsenal).
90+2' The referee allows time for a substitution. Thomas Partey will be replaced by Jakub Kiwior (Arsenal).
90+2' Omari Forson (Manchester United) sends a teasing cross into the area, but David Raya intercepts the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
90' Declan Rice (Arsenal) sends a sweet pass into the box towards Gabriel Martinelli. He looks to dribble past an opposing player, but fails and the ball is cleared.
89' The game is interrupted as Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is flagged offside.
88' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ethan Wheatley (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Rasmus Hojlund cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Erik ten Hag prepares a substitution. Aaron Wan-Bissaka is replaced by Omari Forson (Manchester United).
87' We are about to witness a subsitution. Christian Eriksen (Manchester United) for Sofyan Amrabat.
86' Kobbie Mainoo (Manchester United) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
86' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
83' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.

83' Declan Rice (Arsenal) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom right corner, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Arsenal win a corner.
83' Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) swings in a cross from the corner, but Andre Onana reads it well and gathers the ball.
82' Problems for Mikel Arteta as Bukayo Saka is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Gabriel Jesus (Arsenal) replaces him.
81' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Arsenal.
81' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends the corner into the box, but David Raya intercepts it and averts the threat.
81' It doesn’t look good for Bukayo Saka (Arsenal); looks like he’ll have to leave the pitch!
80' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears. The linesman makes the right call and Manchester Utd will have a corner.
79' The resulting corner from Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

79' Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal) cuts inside his marker and unleashes a rocket of a shot from inside the box. The ball flies towards the roof of the net, but it's kept out by magnificent save from Andre Onana. The ball goes out of play. Arsenal are awarded a corner kick.
77' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a brilliant pass and wastes a big opportunity as his shot from inside the penalty area flies narrowly wide of the left post.
76' Antony (Manchester United) makes a strong challenge and Paul Tierney blows for a foul.
75' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Jonny Evans as he is replaced by Willy Kambwala (Manchester United).
74' Sofyan Amrabat (Manchester United) produces a long-range volley, but the ball was blocked by a defender on its way.
72' Antony (Manchester United) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels low towards the middle of the target, but David Raya easily deals with the threat.
71' A yellow card for a tackle by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). Paul Tierney doesn't hesitate at all to make this decision.
71' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Paul Tierney no option but to blow his whistle.
70' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) takes the corner with a short pass.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Antony (Manchester United) is coming onto the pitch as Amad Diallo cannot continue after picking up an injury.
69' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) tries to pass the ball into the penalty area but it's blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Arsenal.
68' Casemiro (Manchester United) slams the ball towards the middle of the goal, but it fails to surprise David Raya and he's equal to it.
66' That's the end of the game for Leandro Trossard, who is replaced by Gabriel Martinelli (Arsenal).
65' Great touch by Martin Odegaard (Arsenal) as he receives a precise pass deep inside the box and rips a shot goalwards, but the keeper pulls off an amazing save!
64' An attempted cross from Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is cleared.
63' Manchester Utd control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
61' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
59' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) commits a rough challenge and Paul Tierney blows his whistle for a foul.
58' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
57' William Saliba (Arsenal) connects with the corner but his looping header goes well over.
57' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) steps up to send the ball in.

57' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The ball goes behind for a corner. Arsenal will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
56' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) sends a low pass into the box, towards Bukayo Saka. However, he takes one touch too many and loses it to one of the defenders.
55' Declan Rice (Arsenal) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender.
53' Rough tackle by Bukayo Saka (Arsenal). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) found some space to dink a cross from the side into the box, but it needed to be more precise to threaten the opposition.
51' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
49' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
48' Declan Rice (Arsenal) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Casemiro (Manchester United) sends a long ball in, but David Raya comfortably gathers the ball.
46' Paul Tierney blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+4' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) latches on to a cross on the edge of the box and fires a shot at goal, but his effort was blocked by one of the defenders.
45+2' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) serves up a nice cross, but David Raya punches the ball away.
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
43' Half-chance! Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) plays a pass into the box, but David Raya reacts well to snuff out the attack.
42' The ball is cleared after Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
41' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) is penalised for a foul. Paul Tierney had a clear view and blows his whistle.
40' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) is about to take a corner kick.

40' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. Manchester Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
39' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' Looks like Amad Diallo (Manchester United) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
37' Amad Diallo (Manchester United) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
34' A cross from Casemiro (Manchester United) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
33' Scott McTominay (Manchester United) receives a pass and unleashes a shot which goes well wide of the right post.
31' The defender did brilliantly to block the long-range effort from Casemiro (Manchester United).
31' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) sends a low pass from outside the box to Scott McTominay. He lines up a shot, but the defence intercepts at the last moment.
30' Ben White (Arsenal) plays a through ball which would have led to a great opportunity, if it hadn't been stopped by the defence.
29' Ben White (Arsenal) sends in a shot from a promising distance after a precise pass. His effort goes inches over the crossbar.
28' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
25' Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
24' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) commits a foul and Paul Tierney immediately signals a free kick.
23' Ben White (Arsenal) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
20' 0 - 1 Goal! A sublime pass across goal by Kai Havertz evaded the goalkeeper and allowed Leandro Trossard (Arsenal) to tap the ball into an empty net. 0:1.
19' Takehiro Tomiyasu (Arsenal) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
18' Arsenal seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
16' Diogo Dalot (Manchester United) bangs the ball towards goal from the edge of the box, but it's rising all the way and sails high over the bar.
15' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Manchester Utd comes to nothing.
14' Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared. Manchester Utd have a corner.
14' Ben White (Arsenal) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Andre Onana comes off the line to clear the ball away.
12' Manchester Utd are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
10' Gabriel (Arsenal) times his run and jump perfectly to get on the end of the resulting corner, but the ball comes off the top of his head and goes miles over the bar.
9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) will take the corner.

9' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball is out of play and Arsenal manage to earn a corner.
8' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) launches a cross from the corner, but David Raya is alert to thwart the effort.
7' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Manchester Utd.
6' Alejandro Garnacho (Manchester United) goes on a mazy run and ends with a shot from the edge of the box, but a defender makes a decent block.
5' A mistake by a defender gifts Rasmus Hojlund (Manchester United) a chance inside the box, but his wild effort goes high over the bar.
4' A fine pass finds Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) in space inside the box, he looks up and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Andre Onana reacts superbly to deny him.
2' Bukayo Saka (Arsenal) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
2' Declan Rice (Arsenal) whips in the corner, but one of the defending players gets a head on it and intercepts.

1' Kai Havertz (Arsenal) plays a dangerous chip pass into the box in an attempt to set up one of his teammates, but the effort is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out for a corner. Arsenal can continue in their attacking effort.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out and the match is about to start. Arsenal will have the kick-off.
Paul Tierney will officiate today.
